acceptance.criterion_verbatim: RB6-AC3 -- a :focus-visible rule actually PAINTS a ring. (6) prefers-reduced-motion: /market with reduce, 42 of 42 at the full ring 140 ms after Tab; without reduce, 20 of 42, the rest mid-transition.
(7) The shell off the accent: SHELL-ACCENT-FILL 2/2/2 before, 0/0/0 after on /market, /positioning and /portfolio-management; the /positioning capture read.
